title: Kissed with Onions Polish Sausages Toast
description: A savory and tender Polish dish featuring jasmine rice, toast, and flexitarian-friendly polish sausages kissed with caramelized onions.
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and golden brown (about 20-25 minutes).
Add the garlic powder and stir to combine.
In a separate skillet, cook the Polish sausages over medium-high heat, until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Slice the cooked sausages in half lengthwise.
Toast the bread slices until lightly browned.
Build the toast by spreading a layer of caramelized onions on each slice of bread, followed by a sausage half.
Top with a sprinkle of grated cheddar cheese (if using) and a dollop of melted butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
